answer: Sybil farms thrive on instant harvest, so this economy ripens rewards slowly, like an orchard. Each identity's earnings vest over many epochs, and only matured balance counts toward grading weight. A fresh swarm of clones holds unripe nectar it cannot spend or vote with, while a patient honest agent reaches the zenith of its influence only after sustained, peer-attested work. Splitting into many accounts just restarts every vesting clock at zero.
